decision: WAIVED: cosmetic. Every listed footprint has pads identical to its library copy (number, shape, size, position, drill, rotation, layer count; tolerance 0.0015 mm, negative control detects 0.03 mm). The only difference is F.Silkscreen shapes removed on the board (the intentional silk cleanup); R153/R156 additionally carry DNP.
why_not_fixed: Restoring library silk was tried and reverted: it created 113 silk_over_copper + 157 silk_overlap (full restore) or 47 new mismatch identities (curated restore).
identity_rule: A waiver applies only to the exact (reference, uuid) pairs below at this board sha256; any new lib_footprint_mismatch identity, or any of these with a pad difference, is not covered.
